description: HVAC for mega_cruise_5000 cabin-corridor layout. Nine deck-level passenger AHU branches, four crew-deck branches, plus existing public/service networks. Cross-deck trunk links at reduced flow vs legacy two-zone cabin model.

hvac_zones.description: Forward public venues and theater complex. High ACH for large assembly.
Midship multi-deck atrium, promenade, and enclosed public spaces.
Aft dining, pool deck, buffet, and recreation venues.
Crew accommodation and messing areas.
Dedicated medical exhaust. Medical Center at 10-12 ACH, Isolation Ward at 12 ACH (100% negative exhaust, HEPA filtered before overboard).
High-volume service exhaust for galleys, laundry, and waste processing.
Engine room forced ventilation and combustion air supply. Massive airflow, non-recirculating to accommodation.

cross_zone_links.description: Airflow drawn from dining rooms into galleys to maintain negative pressure in galleys, exhausting odors overboard.
Passive multi-deck mixing between Royal Promenade and forward theater/public spaces.
Negative pressure in engine room draws passive air from lower crew service corridors.
Minimal passive leakage; Medical and Isolation Ward kept strictly negative relative to surrounding crew/public corridors.
